# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 batch 11 fs-frontier1, the settlement of a conquered crown. Generated by gen_frontier.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ======================================================================== registration (engine probe P1)
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_tgt = the country about to be annexed (or, HOOK war_end, the loser before the peace terms).
# Only variables. Called by the on_action hook of this line (mode annex); confirmed by the 'after' hook (oe_fs_after_annex) or, when it never came, the monthly check one month later.
# $via$: 1 the annexation hook, 2 the war-end hook, 9 a test button.
oe_fs_register = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_fs_serial } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_fs_serial value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_fs_serial add = 1 }
    oe_fs_forget_last = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_cur value = global_var:oe_fs_serial }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_via value = $via$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_reg_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_src_n value = 0 }
    clear_variable_list = oe_fs_locs
    scope:oe_fs_tgt = {
        every_owned_location = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_batch value = global_var:oe_fs_serial }
            save_scope_as = oe_fs_l
            c:BYZ = {
                add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_fs_locs target = scope:oe_fs_l }
                change_variable = { name = oe_fs_src_n add = 1 }
            }
        }
        capital ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_c }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_c } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_old_cap value = scope:oe_fs_c } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_rank value = 2 }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_tgt = { country_rank_level >= 3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_rank value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_fs_tgt = { country_rank_level >= 4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_rank value = 4 } }
    scope:oe_fs_tgt = { ruler ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes } save_scope_as = oe_fs_k } } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_k }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_king value = scope:oe_fs_k }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The annexation went through (P1 'after' hook, or HOOK war_end: the loser is gone).
oe_fs_confirm = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_via ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_via value = 11 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_check value = 1 months = 3 }
}
# BYZ scope. What the previous batch left for the texts and oe_fs.2 (a new batch starts clean).
oe_fs_forget_last = {
    remove_variable = oe_fs_err
    remove_variable = oe_fs_kerr
    remove_variable = oe_fs_new_th1
    remove_variable = oe_fs_new_th2
    remove_variable = oe_fs_new_th3
    remove_variable = oe_fs_new_ally
    remove_variable = oe_fs_king
}
# BYZ scope. Drop the open batch: marks on its locations, the plan, the waits. Crown marks (oe_fs_crown) stay; so do the
# former king (oe_fs_king) and the records of the settlement, which oe_fs.2 still needs.
oe_fs_clear_batch = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = oe_fs_locs
        remove_variable = oe_fs_batch
        remove_variable = oe_fs_rest
        remove_variable = oe_fs_crown_pick
    }
    clear_variable_list = oe_fs_locs
    remove_variable = oe_fs_cur
    remove_variable = oe_fs_check
    remove_variable = oe_fs_pending
    remove_variable = oe_fs_sent
    remove_variable = oe_fs_wait
    remove_variable = oe_fs_reg_m
    remove_variable = oe_fs_old_cap
    remove_variable = oe_fs_seat1
    remove_variable = oe_fs_seat2
    remove_variable = oe_fs_seat3
    remove_variable = oe_fs_job
}

# ======================================================================== the month (scheduler row 29)
# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 29); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. One event at most a month; the lock is taken by the events themselves.
oe_fs_monthly = {
    # P1: a registration whose 'after' hook never came is checked from the month after (oe_fs_via stays 1).
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_cur NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_check } NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_pending } has_variable = oe_fs_reg_m var:oe_fs_reg_m < oe_ml_month_now }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_check value = 1 months = 3 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_check } oe_fs_check_step = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_pending }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_sent } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_fs_wait add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { OR = { AND = { oe_ml_free = yes oe_fs_calm = yes } var:oe_fs_wait >= 10 } }
                oe_fs_send_1 = yes
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_k2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_k2_sent } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { oe_fs_king_ok = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_kerr value = 1 }
            debug_log = "oe_fs: the former ruler is gone before oe_fs.2 (engine probe P2: kerr 1)"
            remove_variable = oe_fs_k2
            remove_variable = oe_fs_k2_wait
            remove_variable = oe_fs_king
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_k2_wait } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_k2_wait value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_fs_k2_wait add = 1 }
            if = { limit = { OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_fs_k2_wait >= 3 } } oe_fs_send_2 = yes }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Step 1 (design 3.2.2): the open land of the batch; a batch with too little of it, or whose old capital the
# empire does not hold, is dropped without a pop-up.
oe_fs_check_step = {
    remove_variable = oe_fs_check
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_open_n value = 0 }
    every_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs limit = { oe_fs_open = yes } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_fs_open_n add = 1 } } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_open_n >= 4 var:oe_fs_old_cap ?= { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
        set_variable = oe_fs_pending
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_wait value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_fs: a batch of [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_open_n')|0] open locations waits for oe_fs.1"
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_fs_old_cap ?= { owner ?= c:BYZ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_err value = 7 } }
        debug_log = "oe_fs: the batch is dropped (too little open land, or the old capital is not ours)"
        oe_fs_clear_batch = yes
        remove_variable = oe_fs_king
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The sender of oe_fs.1: the split, then the event (the test button fse1 runs this as well).
oe_fs_send_1 = {
    oe_fs_split = yes
    set_variable = oe_fs_sent
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_fs.1
}
# BYZ scope. The sender of oe_fs.2.
oe_fs_send_2 = {
    remove_variable = oe_fs_k2_wait
    set_variable = oe_fs_k2_sent
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_fs.2
}

# BYZ scope. The split (design 3.2.3; the worker's 'job 1' of the design, run by the sender so that the text has its
# numbers): crown estates oe_fs_crown_pick, rest oe_fs_rest, the seats oe_fs_seat1-3 and how many themes (oe_fs_nth).
# Nothing in the world changes here.
oe_fs_split = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_crown_cnt value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_rest_n value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_nth value = 0 }
    remove_variable = oe_fs_seat1
    remove_variable = oe_fs_seat2
    remove_variable = oe_fs_seat3
    every_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs remove_variable = oe_fs_crown_pick remove_variable = oe_fs_rest }
    var:oe_fs_old_cap ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_c }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_c scope:oe_fs_c = { oe_fs_open = yes } }
        scope:oe_fs_c = { set_variable = oe_fs_crown_pick }
        change_variable = { name = oe_fs_crown_cnt add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_c }
        while = {
            count = 6
            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:oe_fs_crown_cnt < 6
                    any_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs oe_fs_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_crown_pick } area = scope:oe_fs_c.area }
                }
                ordered_in_list = {
                    variable = oe_fs_locs
                    limit = { oe_fs_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_crown_pick } area = scope:oe_fs_c.area }
                    order_by = population
                    set_variable = oe_fs_crown_pick
                }
                change_variable = { name = oe_fs_crown_cnt add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = oe_fs_locs
        limit = { oe_fs_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_crown_pick } }
        set_variable = oe_fs_rest
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_fs_rest_n add = 1 } }
    }
    # Too little left: everything is crown land, only option d.
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_rest_n < 3 }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = oe_fs_locs
            limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_rest }
            remove_variable = oe_fs_rest
            set_variable = oe_fs_crown_pick
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_fs_crown_cnt add = var:oe_fs_rest_n }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_rest_n value = 0 }
    }
    # Seats (the provincialisation's rule, oe_tm_provincialise, on the rest): the most populous rest location; from
    # 12 rest locations a second in another area; from 30 a third in yet another area.
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_rest_n >= 3 }
        ordered_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_rest } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_fs_s1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_seat1 value = scope:oe_fs_s1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_nth value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_fs_rest_n >= 12 any_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs has_variable = oe_fs_rest NOT = { area = scope:oe_fs_s1.area } } }
            ordered_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_rest NOT = { area = scope:oe_fs_s1.area } } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_fs_s2 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_seat2 value = scope:oe_fs_s2 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_nth value = 2 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_fs_rest_n >= 30 any_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs has_variable = oe_fs_rest NOT = { area = scope:oe_fs_s1.area } NOT = { area = scope:oe_fs_s2.area } } }
                ordered_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_rest NOT = { area = scope:oe_fs_s1.area } NOT = { area = scope:oe_fs_s2.area } } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_fs_s3 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_fs_seat3 value = scope:oe_fs_s3 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_fs_nth value = 3 }
            }
        }
    }
}

# ======================================================================== the settlement (worker oe_fs.90)
# BYZ scope. The entry point for any caller (design 4.2; the strong route may use it on a batch it registers itself):
# $how$ 1 themes, 2 appanage despotate, 3 native despot as a Roman ally, 4 held directly. Runs the worker's job now.
oe_fs_settle_batch = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_job value = $how$ }
    change_variable = { name = oe_fs_job add = 10 }
    oe_fs_work = yes
}
# BYZ scope. The worker (oe_fs.90 runs it): jobs 11-14 the four options of oe_fs.1, 21-25 the options of oe_fs.2.
oe_fs_work = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_job has_variable = oe_fs_cur var:oe_fs_job >= 11 var:oe_fs_job <= 14 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_n value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_crown_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_crown_n value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_theme_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_theme_n value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_dsp_in_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_dsp_in_n value = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_dsp_out_n } } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_dsp_out_n value = 0 } }
        oe_fs_crown_apply = yes
        if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_job = 11 } oe_fs_do_a = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_job = 12 } oe_fs_do_b = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_job = 13 } oe_fs_do_c = yes }
        else = { oe_fs_do_d = yes }
        oe_fs_finish = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_job ?= 21 }
        oe_fs_king_court = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_job ?= 22 }
        oe_fs_king_monk = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_job ?= 23 }
        oe_fs_king_despot = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_fs_job ?= 24 }
        oe_fs_king_strategos = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_job var:oe_fs_job >= 21 }
        remove_variable = oe_fs_k2
        remove_variable = oe_fs_k2_sent
        remove_variable = oe_fs_k2_wait
        remove_variable = oe_fs_king
    }
    remove_variable = oe_fs_job
}
# BYZ scope. Every option first: the crown estates (design 3.2.3).
oe_fs_crown_apply = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = oe_fs_locs
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_crown_pick owner ?= c:BYZ }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_crown_land years = 20 mode = replace }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_crown value = global_var:oe_fs_serial }
        remove_variable = oe_fs_crown_pick
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_fs_crown_n add = 1 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. a: themes on the rest (oe_tm_found_n, oe_tm_post, oe_tm_set_new_status), self-check, the price.
oe_fs_do_a = {
    var:oe_fs_seat1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tm_seat1 }
    var:oe_fs_seat2 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tm_seat2 }
    var:oe_fs_seat3 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tm_seat3 }
    oe_fs_found_seats = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th1 }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = oe_fs_locs
            limit = { oe_fs_rest_open = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tm_to value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th2 } if = { limit = { oe_tm_d2 < oe_tm_d1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_to value = 2 } } }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th3 } if = { limit = { oe_tm_d3 < oe_tm_d1 oe_tm_d3 < oe_tm_d2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_to value = 3 } } }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_tm_to ?= 3 exists = scope:oe_tm_th3 } oe_tm_post = { n = 3 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tm_to ?= 2 exists = scope:oe_tm_th2 } oe_tm_post = { n = 2 } }
            else = { oe_tm_post = { n = 1 } }
            remove_variable = oe_tm_to
        }
        oe_fs_after_themes = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_built value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th2 } change_variable = { name = oe_fs_built add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th3 } change_variable = { name = oe_fs_built add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_built >= 3 } oe_fs_auth_add = { amount = -11 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_fs_built >= 2 } oe_fs_auth_add = { amount = -8 } }
        else = { oe_fs_auth_add = { amount = -5 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_fs_theme_n add = var:oe_fs_built }
        remove_variable = oe_fs_built
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_err value = 2 }
        oe_fs_do_d = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. b: one theme at the first seat, then the eldest prince of the house as despot (oe_ti_grant_despotate_do,
# which charges 10 Authority and 10 prestige itself, and sends oe_ti.30).
oe_fs_do_b = {
    var:oe_fs_seat1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tm_seat1 }
    oe_fs_found_seats = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th1 }
        every_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs limit = { oe_fs_rest_open = yes } oe_tm_post = { n = 1 } }
        oe_fs_after_themes = yes
        change_variable = { name = oe_fs_theme_n add = 1 }
        ordered_character = {
            limit = { oe_ti_despot_candidate = yes is_eligible_heir_baseline = scope:oe_tm_th1 }
            order_by = age_in_years
            save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_char
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_ti_dsp_char oe_ti_can_grant_despotate = yes }
            scope:oe_tm_th1 = { save_scope_as = oe_ti_dsp_theme }
            oe_ti_grant_despotate_do = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_tm_th1 = { var:oe_theme_status ?= 5 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_fs_dsp_in_n add = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_fs_err value = 5 } }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_err value = 2 }
        oe_fs_do_d = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. a and b: found the themes whose seats are saved (scope:oe_tm_seat1-3), the empire still holding each.
oe_fs_found_seats = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_seat1 scope:oe_tm_seat1 = { oe_fs_open = yes } }
        oe_tm_found_1 = yes
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th1 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_new_th1 value = scope:oe_tm_th1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th1 exists = scope:oe_tm_seat2 scope:oe_tm_seat2 = { oe_fs_open = yes } }
            oe_tm_found_2 = yes
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th2 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_new_th2 value = scope:oe_tm_th2 } }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th2 exists = scope:oe_tm_seat3 scope:oe_tm_seat3 = { oe_fs_open = yes } }
                oe_tm_found_3 = yes
                if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th3 } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_new_th3 value = scope:oe_tm_th3 } }
            }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. a and b after the posts: self-check (design 3.2.6), the themes' status, the new-rule modifier.
oe_fs_after_themes = {
    if = {
        limit = { any_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs oe_fs_rest_open = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_err value = 1 }
        every_in_list = { variable = oe_fs_locs limit = { oe_fs_rest_open = yes } oe_tm_post = { n = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th1 } oe_tm_set_new_status = { n = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th2 } oe_tm_set_new_status = { n = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th3 } oe_tm_set_new_status = { n = 3 } }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = oe_fs_locs
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_rest owner ?= c:BYZ }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_new_rule years = 5 mode = replace }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. c: a local lord as despot, a Roman ally (engine probe P3 in oe_fs_build_ally); self-check and roll-back.
oe_fs_do_c = {
    var:oe_fs_seat1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_seat }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_seat scope:oe_fs_seat = { oe_fs_open = yes } }
        oe_fs_build_ally = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_ally_ok = yes }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = oe_fs_locs
            limit = { oe_fs_rest_open = yes }
            change_location_owner = scope:oe_fs_ally
        }
        scope:oe_fs_ally = {
            set_country_rank = country_rank:rank_duchy
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_ally_of value = global_var:oe_fs_serial }
            ruler ?= { reset_ruler_title = {} }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_new_ally value = scope:oe_fs_ally }
        add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
        change_variable = { name = oe_fs_dsp_out_n add = 1 }
        oe_fs_ally_dignity = yes
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_ally } annex_country = { country = scope:oe_fs_ally reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_err value = 3 }
        oe_fs_do_d = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_seat. Engine probe P3, the ONE place that builds the native despotate (switch BUILD = one_step).
# Government, religion and culture are set at the building (r20 lesson: before the ruler is made); the religion is the
# seat's Christian majority (oe_fs_christian_seat), the culture that of its largest pop.
oe_fs_build_ally = {
    scope:oe_fs_seat = {
        ordered_pop = { order_by = pop_size max = 1 check_range_bounds = no culture = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_cul } }
        if = { limit = { religion_percentage = { religion = religion:orthodox value >= 0.5 } } religion:orthodox = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_rel } }
        else = { religion:catholic = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_rel } }
    }
    scope:oe_fs_seat = {
        if = {
        	limit = { has_owner = yes }
	        create_country_from_location = {
	            overlord = c:BYZ
	            subject_type = subject_type:oe_rome_sub
	            save_scope_as = oe_fs_ally
	            change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
	            change_country_type = location
	            change_heir_selection = heir_selection:cognatic_primogeniture
	            change_religion = scope:oe_fs_rel
	            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_cul } change_culture = scope:oe_fs_cul }
	        }
        }
    }
    # one step that built a country which is not our subject: the second step repairs it (code 4, for the probe)
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_ally NOT = { scope:oe_fs_ally = { is_subject_of = c:BYZ } } }
        scope:oe_fs_ally = { make_subject_of = { target = c:BYZ type = subject_type:oe_rome_sub } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_err value = 4 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_ally exists = scope:oe_fs_cul }
        scope:oe_fs_ally = { set_court_language = scope:oe_fs_cul.dialect }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_fs_ally. The despot's dignity when a place is free (gen_despot_diplomacy.py's own rule and price,
# through its caller contract: oe_dsp_t is set by the caller and cleared again; a value already there is put back).
oe_fs_ally_dignity = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } set_variable = { name = oe_fs_dsp_t_kept value = var:oe_dsp_t } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_t value = scope:oe_fs_ally }
    if = { limit = { oe_dsp_can_despotes = yes } oe_dsp_confer = { t = despotes } }
    remove_variable = oe_dsp_t
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_dsp_t_kept } set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_t value = var:oe_fs_dsp_t_kept } remove_variable = oe_fs_dsp_t_kept }
}
# BYZ scope. d (and the fallback of a, b, c): the rest is held directly, with the lighter crown-land modifier.
oe_fs_do_d = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = oe_fs_locs
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_rest owner ?= c:BYZ }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_held_land years = 10 mode = replace }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. After every option: the records, the empire's modifier, oe_fs.2 next month when the former ruler lives,
# the batch closed.
oe_fs_finish = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_fs_n add = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_last value = var:oe_fs_job }
    change_variable = { name = oe_fs_last add = -10 }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_crown_won years = 10 mode = replace }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_king_ok = yes }
        set_variable = oe_fs_k2
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_k2_wait value = 0 }
    }
    else = { remove_variable = oe_fs_king }
    oe_fs_clear_batch = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Pillars Authority up or down by $amount$ (0-100).
oe_fs_auth_add = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	        if = {
	            limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority }
	            change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ }
	            clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
	        }
	    }
	}
}

# ======================================================================== the former ruler (engine probe P2)
# BYZ scope. The ONE place that moves the former ruler to court (oe_fs.2's immediate; the test button fsp2). Failure
# code oe_fs_kerr 2 when he is alive but not at the empire's court afterwards (oe_fs.2 then offers only e).
oe_fs_king_take = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_king_ok = yes NOT = { oe_fs_king_here = yes } }
        var:oe_fs_king = { move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_king_ok = yes NOT = { oe_fs_king_here = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_kerr value = 2 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .2 a: a court dignity in the City.
oe_fs_king_court = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_king_here = yes }
        var:oe_fs_king = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_exking_court years = -1 mode = replace } }
        add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .2 b: a monastery.
oe_fs_king_monk = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_king_here = yes }
        var:oe_fs_king = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_fs_exking_monk years = -1 mode = replace } }
        add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .2 c: back to his land as the despot of the new ally (the provincialisation's way with oe_tm.1 a).
oe_fs_king_despot = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_king_here = yes oe_fs_ally_alive = yes }
        var:oe_fs_new_ally = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_a }
        var:oe_fs_king = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_k }
        scope:oe_fs_a = { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_prev } }
        scope:oe_fs_k = { move_country = scope:oe_fs_a }
        scope:oe_fs_a = {
            set_new_ruler = scope:oe_fs_k
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_fs_old_house target = c:BYZ }
        }
        scope:oe_fs_k = { reset_ruler_title = {} }
        scope:oe_fs_prev ?= { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_ruler_of = scope:oe_fs_a } } kill_character_silently = this } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .2 d: the first strategos of the new theme (as oe_tm.1 a).
oe_fs_king_strategos = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_king_here = yes oe_fs_theme_alive = yes }
        var:oe_fs_new_th1 = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_t1 }
        var:oe_fs_king = { save_scope_as = oe_fs_k }
        scope:oe_fs_t1 = { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_fs_prev } }
        scope:oe_fs_k = { move_country = scope:oe_fs_t1 }
        scope:oe_fs_t1 = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_fs_k oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 10 } }
        scope:oe_fs_k = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } } add_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } }
        scope:oe_fs_prev ?= { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_ruler_of = scope:oe_fs_t1 } } kill_character_silently = this } }
    }
}

# ======================================================================== readout and test helpers (test page 30)
# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts.
oe_fs_log = { debug_log = "oe_fs serial=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_serial')|0] cur=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_cur')|0] via=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_via')|0] check=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_check')|0] pending=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_pending')|0] src=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_src_n')|0] open=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_open_n')|0] crown=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_crown_cnt')|0] rest=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_rest_n')|0] nth=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_nth')|0] err=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_err')|0] king=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_king')|0] k2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_k2')|0] kerr=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_kerr')|0] last=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_last')|0] n=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_n')|0] crown_n=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_crown_n')|0] theme_n=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_theme_n')|0] dsp_in=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_dsp_in_n')|0] dsp_out=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_fs_v_dsp_out_n')|0]" }
# BYZ scope. fsmark: a fake batch from the empire's own land that no theme holds (design 4.5): the most populous such
# location and up to 9 more of its area, then up to 10 in all from anywhere; old capital = the first; rank 3.
oe_fs_test_mark = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_cur } oe_fs_clear_batch = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_fs_k2
    remove_variable = oe_fs_k2_wait
    remove_variable = oe_fs_k2_sent
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_fs_serial } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_fs_serial value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_fs_serial add = 1 }
    oe_fs_forget_last = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_cur value = global_var:oe_fs_serial }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_via value = 9 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_reg_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_rank value = 3 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_src_n value = 0 }
    clear_variable_list = oe_fs_locs
    ordered_owned_location = { limit = { oe_fs_test_free = yes } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_fs_anchor }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_anchor }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_old_cap value = scope:oe_fs_anchor }
        while = {
            count = 10
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_fs_src_n < 10 any_owned_location = { oe_fs_test_free = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_batch } area = scope:oe_fs_anchor.area } }
                ordered_owned_location = { limit = { oe_fs_test_free = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_batch } area = scope:oe_fs_anchor.area } order_by = population oe_fs_test_take = yes }
            }
        }
        while = {
            count = 10
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_fs_src_n < 10 any_owned_location = { oe_fs_test_free = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_batch } } }
                ordered_owned_location = { limit = { oe_fs_test_free = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_fs_batch } } order_by = population oe_fs_test_take = yes }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_fs_check value = 1 months = 3 }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs test: the empire holds no land outside the themes (fsmark needs some; use fsp1 instead)" }
}
# Location scope (fsmark). Into the fake batch.
oe_fs_test_take = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_fs_batch value = global_var:oe_fs_serial }
    save_scope_as = oe_fs_l
    c:BYZ = {
        add_to_variable_list = { name = oe_fs_locs target = scope:oe_fs_l }
        change_variable = { name = oe_fs_src_n add = 1 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. fse1: step 1 now (when a batch waits for it), then the sender (ignores the lock and the civil wars).
oe_fs_test_e1 = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_check } oe_fs_check_step = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_pending } oe_fs_send_1 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs test: no batch waits for oe_fs.1 (press fsmark first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. fse2: oe_fs.2 now.
oe_fs_test_e2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_king_ok = yes }
        set_variable = oe_fs_k2
        oe_fs_send_2 = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs test: no former ruler is stored, or he is dead or a child (fskingx makes one)" }
}
# BYZ scope. fsp1 (probe P1): annex by script a neighbouring AI country the registration accepts; the readout tells
# whether the hook registered it (via 1 or 11) and whether the 'after' hook came (11).
oe_fs_test_p1 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_annexer_ok = yes }
        random_country = {
            limit = { is_ai = yes oe_fs_target_ok = yes is_neighbor_of_country_or_across_one_seazone = c:BYZ NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
            save_scope_as = oe_fs_p1
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_fs_p1 }
            annex_country = { country = scope:oe_fs_p1 reason = MilitaryConquest transfer = yes }
            oe_fs_log = yes
        }
        else = { debug_log = "oe_fs probe P1: no neighbouring AI country of rank duchy or above with 6+ locations and its capital in an old Roman region" }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs probe P1: a batch or a former ruler is pending, or a civil war or campaign runs (press fsclr first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. fsp2 (probe P2): bring the stored former ruler to court now, without the event, and log the result.
oe_fs_test_p2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_fs_king_ok = yes }
        oe_fs_king_take = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_fs_king_here = yes } debug_log = "oe_fs probe P2: the former ruler lives and is at the empire's court" }
        else = { debug_log = "oe_fs probe P2: the former ruler lives but could not be brought to court (kerr 2)" }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_king }
        debug_log = "oe_fs probe P2: the stored former ruler is gone or not adult (kerr 1 in a real run)"
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs probe P2: no former ruler was stored (none, a child, or the hook did not run)" }
}
# BYZ scope. fsp3 (probe P3): option c at once, without the event: step 1 and the split when needed, then the worker's
# job 13 (build, self-check, roll-back); the readout gives oe_fs_err (0 fine, 3 rolled back, 4 repaired by step two).
oe_fs_test_p3 = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_check } oe_fs_check_step = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_pending }
        oe_fs_split = yes
        if = {
            limit = { oe_fs_can_c = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_fs_job value = 13 }
            oe_fs_work = yes
            oe_fs_log = yes
        }
        else = { debug_log = "oe_fs probe P3: option c is not open for this batch (too little rest land, or the seat is not Christian)" }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_fs probe P3: no batch (press fsmark first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. fsclr: forget every mark of this line (themes and countries already made stay).
oe_fs_test_reset = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_fs_cur } oe_fs_clear_batch = yes }
    oe_fs_forget_last = yes
    remove_variable = oe_fs_last
    remove_variable = oe_fs_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_crown_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_theme_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_dsp_in_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_dsp_out_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_open_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_crown_cnt
    remove_variable = oe_fs_rest_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_nth
    remove_variable = oe_fs_rank
    remove_variable = oe_fs_src_n
    remove_variable = oe_fs_via
    remove_variable = oe_fs_k2
    remove_variable = oe_fs_k2_wait
    remove_variable = oe_fs_k2_sent
}
